parso mummy ka birthday hai, cake order karna hai. kya suggest karoge?
7:33 AM

Mummy ke liye ye teen cakes safe rahenge, Sat 24 Oct ke liye 1 din pehle order kar do:

Butterscotch ya pineapple: simple aur sabko pasand aane wala.
Chocolate truffle: agar mummy ko chocolate pasand hai.
Photo cake: unki koi favourite photo cake par, personal lagta hai.

Agar mummy ko meetha kam pasand hai, to eggless fruit cake ya mawa cake bhi achha rahega. Cake kal tak order kar do, taaki parso subah tak delivery pakki ho.

Is Mon 2 Nov a holiday in Mumbai?
7:33 AM

Mon 2 Nov isn't a public holiday in Mumbai as far as I know, so banks and offices should be open. I haven't checked a live holiday list, so confirm with your bank or office if it matters. Diwali falls on the weekend before, around Sun 8 Nov.
